thread:
dave_acme: Hey, after the v6m canary swap our JSON-mode outputs changed shape. Numbers that used to be ints are coming back as strings and nested objects are flattened into dotted keys. Repo steps and example below — this is breaking our webhook consumers.

Sophia (support): Sorry to hear that — can you paste a minimal request/response and a request_id? Which exact model tag did you hit (e.g. v6m-canary)?

Dave: Model was v6m-canary in us-east-1. Repro (sanitized):

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"v6m-canary","mode":"json","input":"Summarize order: {\"id\": 12345, \"items\": [{\"sku\": \"A1\", \"qty\": 2}], \"total\": 49}"}'
```

Expected response (compact):

```json
{"id":12345,"items":[{"sku":"A1","qty":2}],"total":49}
```

Actual response we received (truncated):

```json
{"id":"12345","items.sku":"A1","items.qty":"2","total":"49"}
```

Also sometimes nested arrays are flattened into multiple keys like "items.0.sku" depending on the input.

sophia_support: Thanks, that example is super helpful. Can you include a request_id from the response headers (x-request-id) if you have it? Also, did you see this immediately after the canary, or did it appear later?

Dave: x-request-id: rq_2026_2799987699_abc123. It started after the canary went live this morning (~2799987600).

deploy-bot: Deployment event: v6m-canary promoted in us-east-1 at 2799987600 by ci/cd (rollout-id: rollout_984).

liam_eng: Looking. Initial glance — flattened keys + stringified numbers suggests the JSON post-processor is seeing token boundaries that split numeric tokens across chunks and then applying a safe-string wrapper. Could be an interaction between the streaming chunk boundaries and the JSON-mode reconstructor.

megha_eng_ml: Adding context: the v6m canary includes a new quantization kernel and a tiny change to the detokenizer merge behavior. If the tokenizer yields a token boundary inside a numeric literal, and the reassembly logic is expecting stable tokenization, we might end up inserting quotes or collapsing arrays into dotted keys when trying to repair partial objects.

sophia_support: For immediate mitigation — can you try pinning to v6m-stable or the previous 6.x tag? That should restore previous behavior while we investigate. If customer needs a live fix, we can coordinate a rollback.

liam_eng: Requesting full raw streaming_writes for rq_2026_2799987699_abc123 (raw chunks, not post-processed). Also need the exact payload size and sequence of chunk boundaries. If customer can attach a raw capture (curl --no-buffer) or a network capture that preserves chunk delimiters, that would be ideal.

Dave: Uploading raw capture to the ticket now: https://redwood-internal/attachments/rq_2026_2799987699_abc123.log — sent. We rely on the API, can't pin to older model long-term but can for a few hours if needed.

megha_eng_ml: Got the log. Quick read: there are cases where numeric sequences are split across two streaming frames and our "safe-string" fallback is executed in the structured-output glue code. This path was exercised more frequently because tokenization changed (quant kernel).

liam_eng: Action plan: 1) short-term: recommend customer pin to v6m-stable or set model_version parameter to v6m@20260215 (known-good). 2) medium-term: we'll patch the JSON-mode reassembly so it doesn't coerce split numeric tokens into quoted strings — reproducer + unit tests in progress. 3) if regression impact > threshold, engage infra for a rollback of v6m-canary in us-east-1.

sophia_support: I've created support ticket SUP-2026-4321 and linked the raw capture. Notifying account team.

Dave: Pin worked, thanks. We'll leave pinned while you patch. Please keep us posted.

liam_eng: We'll post updates in this thread and the incident page. ETA for a hotfix build: ~4-6 hours; if we see more customers impacted we will accelerate. Thanks for the repro logs — they made root cause clear. :thumbsup:

sophia_support: Marking this support thread as escalated to eng-ml. Assigned: MEGHA (owner) + LIAM.

megha_eng_ml: Created internal issue ISSUE-4321-type-shadowing. Starting PR to add robust token-boundary-aware reassembly and extra regression tests that iterate tokenizers + quant kernels. Will follow up with rollout plan.

sophia_support: Closing loop with customer — will update once hotfix is validated in canary.

Dave: Appreciate the quick response.
